QA-100877 is **FAIL**. The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-100877-report.md`.

- **A6 (Organic + Paid Impressions = Impressions): FAIL.** Organic and Paid Impressions show "–" on all 13 Threads posts and on the Sum row, while Impressions is populated (Sum 419,745). The sum can't equal Impressions.
- **A7 (Organic + Paid Reach = Reach): not evaluable.** Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach are all "–" on every post.
- **A8 (Engagements ÷ Impressions = Engagement Rate): PASS** on 13/13 posts, within rounding of the 2-decimal display.
- **A8 (Engaged User Rate shows an en-dash): PASS** on all posts.
- **Brand:** the spec says "Max", but the HBO Max account's brand typeahead has no exact "Max". I used its own brand, `HBO Max` (brand_id 155614). The 2026-10-20 run of this case and today's QA-100873 did the same. The report notes the deviation.
- **Known bugs:** no open bug is linked and nothing in `known-quirks.md` covers this. The result is identical to the 2026-10-20 run, so I kept FAIL. A6 looks like a spec or product question: Threads has no organic/paid impressions split.
- **Not done:** no Jira ticket was filed (markdown only), and no skill or registry maintenance was done, as instructed.
